character_backstory: Wren was apprenticed to Old Hesper, the hedge-mage of Thornhallow, a border town on the King's Road where the kingdom of Aldmere frays into the Greywold hills. Hesper taught him candle-magic and the reading of old script, then died last winter owing the Chandlers' Guild for three years of wax. The guild has given Wren until the harvest fair to pay or lose the cottage. He knows the ruins of the old road better than anyone still living in Thornhallow, and keeps Hesper's brass-bound grimoire, half of which he still cannot read.
custom_style: Classic high fantasy: a border town of the kingdom of Aldmere on the old King's Road, with older ruins in the hills, a lord's keep, temples, guilds, and magic that is common utility rather than miracle. Elves, dwarves and beastfolk alongside humans. Grounded adventure, neither grimdark nor cozy.

special_abilities.name: Candlelight
special_abilities.description: Wren calls a mote of steady flame-coloured light to his palm. It lights a room, shows fresh tracks and old script more clearly, and can be set on a surface to burn for an hour.

growth.grows: brightness, duration and what the light reveals

tone: grounded adventure, dry humour, real stakes
